### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **43** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/owner-fixed-rule.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-hooks.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/user-preference-hooks.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**49** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6f094645b41ac5555fb8e3f94d8b2440d66c7fb5`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/owner-fixed-rule.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-hooks.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/user-preference-hooks.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `PERMISSION_DENIED (literal, 51 pages)`
- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **218** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **157** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **157**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **102** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **53** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6f094645b41ac5555fb8e3f94d8b2440d66c7fb5` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1ea90e68110d3ca8160f9799cdfce175c3737472` — the merge of head `4034a9fbd0ecb08781cb7ca4479d967e419b8649` into base `6f094645b41ac5555fb8e3f94d8b2440d66c7fb5`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1ea90e68110d3ca8160f9799cdfce175c3737472 && git checkout 1ea90e68110d3ca8160f9799cdfce175c3737472
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6f094645b41ac5555fb8e3f94d8b2440d66c7fb5 4034a9fbd0ecb08781cb7ca4479d967e419b8649 && git checkout -B drift-repro 6f094645b41ac5555fb8e3f94d8b2440d66c7fb5 && git merge --no-ff 4034a9fbd0ecb08781cb7ca4479d967e419b8649

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6f094645b41ac5555fb8e3f94d8b2440d66c7fb5
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6f094645b41ac5555fb8e3f94d8b2440d66c7fb5` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：评论表情撤回（plugin-audit）与个人视图删除（plugin-auth）两扇“只删自己的行”的门，原本是两份手抄的同一序列，现在合成 `packages/core` 里的一扇共用门；两个插件只提供对象名、属主列、路由与措辞。
- 为什么改：读为调用者（读不到答 404）、属主核对（不是本人答 403）、再以系统身份带 `attributedUserId` 删除，这段安全相关序列只该有一处；改一处漏另一处的风险消失。
- 风险与回滚：只是搬家，两扇门的回答逐字不变（每扇 17 个请求的状态码、响应体与引擎调用参数搬前搬后逐字节一致）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/own-row-delete-routes.ts` 的 `removeOwnRow` 与 `handleRemoveOwnRow`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/personal-view-routes.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：同形搬移；附带三条注释项（系统身份含应用自动化、manifest 旧注释、偏好创建的括号句已补钉）一并收口。

## 席位核对
